rows.text: El calor cambia la presión, no la mantiene correcta. También en verano hay que revisarla regularmente con los neumáticos fríos.
evidence: Michelin, truck and bus tyre pressure: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — check cold regularly; pressure rises in use, underinflation increases temperature, and an unusually hot tyre needs inspection.

rows.text: Una presión demasiado baja reduce la rigidez lateral del neumático, por lo que el ángulo de deriva puede aumentar para la misma fuerza lateral.
evidence: M. Jagicza, L. I. Nagy and I. Lakatos, Influence of Tire Pressure Distribution on Vehicle Cornering, Vehicles 2026: https://www.mdpi.com/2624-8921/8/7/154 — lower inflation reduces cornering stiffness and increases slip angle at comparable lateral acceleration.

rows.text: Si barro, alquitrán o gravilla se acumulan de forma desigual, añaden masa a una parte de la rueda y pueden desequilibrarla.
evidence: WEGMANN automotive, Product FAQ, static and dynamic imbalance and balancing weights: https://shop.wegmann-automotive.com/en/Brand-world/Product-FAQ/ — asymmetric wheel mass causes hop or wobble; a balancing machine identifies imbalance and weight placement.

Navistar, IK1700018, CV Vibration - wheels, step 3: https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2020/MC-10170959-0001.pdf — mud, snow or debris on the assembly may affect wheel balance; uneven deposits of other solid material have the same mass-distribution effect, an inference from the balancing principle.

rows.text: La distribución desigual de la masa genera fuerzas al girar: la rueda puede rebotar u oscilar lateralmente.
evidence: WEGMANN automotive, Product FAQ, static and dynamic imbalance and balancing weights: https://shop.wegmann-automotive.com/en/Brand-world/Product-FAQ/ — asymmetric wheel mass causes hop or wobble; a balancing machine identifies imbalance and weight placement.
Michelin FAQ, tire balance: https://www.michelinman.com/auto/assistance/michelin-faqs — imbalance produces wheel hop or side-to-side shimmy.

rows.text: Las vibraciones de una rueda desequilibrada pueden transmitirse a la dirección y hacer menos suave la marcha.
evidence: WEGMANN automotive, Product FAQ, static and dynamic imbalance and balancing weights: https://shop.wegmann-automotive.com/en/Brand-world/Product-FAQ/ — asymmetric wheel mass causes hop or wobble; a balancing machine identifies imbalance and weight placement.
Continental, balancing tires: https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/balancing-tires/ — imbalance produces vibrations and affects steering components.

rows.text: En el taller se localiza el desequilibrio con una máquina balanceadora y se colocan contrapesos para compensar la distribución desigual de la masa.
evidence: WEGMANN automotive, Product FAQ, static and dynamic imbalance and balancing weights: https://shop.wegmann-automotive.com/en/Brand-world/Product-FAQ/ — asymmetric wheel mass causes hop or wobble; a balancing machine identifies imbalance and weight placement.

rows.text: El desequilibrio hace rebotar la rueda y puede desgastar la banda de rodadura de forma irregular, creando zonas más desgastadas.
evidence: WEGMANN automotive, Product FAQ, static and dynamic imbalance and balancing weights: https://shop.wegmann-automotive.com/en/Brand-world/Product-FAQ/ — asymmetric wheel mass causes hop or wobble; a balancing machine identifies imbalance and weight placement.

Michelin, wheel alignment and balancing: https://www.michelinman.com/auto/auto-tips-and-advice/tire-maintenance/wheel-alignment-wheel-balancing — camber and toe are alignment angles; imbalance is corrected with weights and causes vibration and cupped wear.

rows.text: Las oscilaciones de una rueda desequilibrada pueden alterar la marcha y el control del vehículo, además de causar vibraciones.
evidence: WEGMANN automotive, Product FAQ, static and dynamic imbalance and balancing weights: https://shop.wegmann-automotive.com/en/Brand-world/Product-FAQ/ — asymmetric wheel mass causes hop or wobble; a balancing machine identifies imbalance and weight placement.
Continental, balancing tires: https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/balancing-tires/ — imbalance causes vibrations and affects steering and suspension.

rows.text: No existe un testigo rojo dedicado al desequilibrio de la rueda. Este suele manifestarse con vibraciones y debe revisarse. El testigo de presión se refiere al inflado.
evidence: WEGMANN automotive, Product FAQ, static and dynamic imbalance and balancing weights: https://shop.wegmann-automotive.com/en/Brand-world/Product-FAQ/ — asymmetric wheel mass causes hop or wobble; a balancing machine identifies imbalance and weight placement.
NHTSA, TireWise, TPMS: https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/tires — pressure monitoring warns of significant underinflation.

rows.text: La caída es un ángulo de alineación; no compensa la distribución desigual de la masa. Una rueda desequilibrada necesita balanceo.
evidence: Michelin, wheel alignment and balancing: https://www.michelinman.com/auto/auto-tips-and-advice/tire-maintenance/wheel-alignment-wheel-balancing — camber and toe are alignment angles; imbalance is corrected with weights and causes vibration and cupped wear.

rows.text: La convergencia se refiere a la orientación de las ruedas, no a la distribución de su masa. El desequilibrio requiere balanceo.
evidence: Michelin, wheel alignment and balancing: https://www.michelinman.com/auto/auto-tips-and-advice/tire-maintenance/wheel-alignment-wheel-balancing — camber and toe are alignment angles; imbalance is corrected with weights and causes vibration and cupped wear.

rows.text: La cámara retiene el aire, pero no corrige la distribución de la masa de la rueda. El rebote causado por desequilibrio requiere balanceo.
evidence: WEGMANN automotive, Product FAQ, static and dynamic imbalance and balancing weights: https://shop.wegmann-automotive.com/en/Brand-world/Product-FAQ/ — asymmetric wheel mass causes hop or wobble; a balancing machine identifies imbalance and weight placement.

rows.text: Aumentar la presión 0,2 bar no elimina un desequilibrio de masa. Hay que ajustar la presión prescrita y balancear la rueda.
evidence: WEGMANN automotive, Product FAQ, static and dynamic imbalance and balancing weights: https://shop.wegmann-automotive.com/en/Brand-world/Product-FAQ/ — asymmetric wheel mass causes hop or wobble; a balancing machine identifies imbalance and weight placement.

rows.text: Reducir la presión 0,4 bar no elimina un desequilibrio de masa. Hay que ajustar la presión prescrita y balancear la rueda.
evidence: WEGMANN automotive, Product FAQ, static and dynamic imbalance and balancing weights: https://shop.wegmann-automotive.com/en/Brand-world/Product-FAQ/ — asymmetric wheel mass causes hop or wobble; a balancing machine identifies imbalance and weight placement.

rows.text: Un neumático dañado puede afectar el control. Hay que reducir la velocidad gradualmente y detenerse en un lugar seguro en cuanto sea posible.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rules 275–276: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/breakdowns-and-incidents-274-to-287 — stop in relative safety; leave by the side away from traffic when safe.
DVSA, Taxi Manual, section 4, blow-outs: https://www.northernireland.gov.uk/sites/default/files/2025-08/taxi-manual-august-2025.pdf — slow gradually and stop under control in a safe place.

rows.text: El cuestionario marca VERO, pero las fuentes consultadas no establecen una relación general entre convergencia excesiva y desgaste interior. La convergencia excesiva suele desgastar el exterior; la divergencia o la caída negativa pueden contribuir al desgaste interior. Las causas pueden combinarse, por lo que deben revisarse la alineación y la suspensión.
evidence: https://www.pirelli.com/global/it-it/road/auto/consigli/tutto-quello-che-c-e-da-sapere-sulla-convergenza-47885/ — Pirelli: convergenza positiva e usura esterna, divergenza e usura interna come tendenze.
https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/advice/tyre-care/wheel-alignment-wheel-balancing — Michelin: campanatura negativa può causare usura interna.

rows.text: En un viaje largo, una revisión puede revelar un neumático anormalmente caliente respecto a los demás. El sobrecalentamiento puede indicar un problema que requiere inspección.
evidence: Michelin, truck and bus tyre pressure: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — check cold regularly; pressure rises in use, underinflation increases temperature, and an unusually hot tyre needs inspection.

rows.text: El bar es una unidad usada para indicar la presión de inflado; el manómetro también puede mostrar otras unidades, como PSI.
evidence: Michelin, inflate tyres: https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/advice/tyre-pressure/inflate-tyres — gauge displays bar or PSI; recommended pressure is in vehicle information, not the sidewall.

rows.text: No se debe cambiar la rueda en cualquier lugar. Primero hay que llegar, si es posible, a un sitio seguro y proteger a los pasajeros según las condiciones del lugar.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rules 275–276: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/breakdowns-and-incidents-274-to-287 — stop in relative safety; leave by the side away from traffic when safe.

rows.text: El mayor desgaste de un lado no se debe exclusivamente al balanceo: también puede causarlo un problema de alineación, como la convergencia o la caída.
evidence: Michelin, wheel alignment and balancing: https://www.michelinman.com/auto/auto-tips-and-advice/tire-maintenance/wheel-alignment-wheel-balancing — camber and toe are alignment angles; imbalance is corrected with weights and causes vibration and cupped wear.
Michelin FAQ, one-sided wear: https://www.michelinman.com/auto/assistance/michelin-faqs — toe, camber and other conditions can cause one shoulder to wear faster.

rows.text: Las paradas no sirven solo para los neumáticos: también permiten descansar al conductor. Los transportes sujetos a las normas pertinentes tienen pausas de conducción previstas.
evidence: Michelin, truck and bus tyre pressure: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — check cold regularly; pressure rises in use, underinflation increases temperature, and an unusually hot tyre needs inspection.
Regulation (EC) 561/2006, article 7: https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2006/561/article/7/2020-12-31 — requires a driving break for drivers within its scope.

rows.text: La presión se indica comúnmente en bar u otras unidades como PSI. La atmósfera es una unidad de presión, pero no es la que generalmente se usa en la indicación aquí considerada.
evidence: Michelin, inflate tyres: https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/advice/tyre-pressure/inflate-tyres — gauge displays bar or PSI; recommended pressure is in vehicle information, not the sidewall.

rows.text: El examen marca la afirmación como falsa, pero su redacción es imprecisa: en el costado puede aparecer una presión máxima. Si se refiere a la presión recomendada para el vehículo, hay que buscarla en la información del fabricante y no deducirla del límite del costado.
evidence: Official quiz, question 30209: https://www.ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/85457073/DOMANDE%2BSUPERIORI23-10.pdf/8673967c-c17e-421d-8f67-b711a33194c1 — the general wording is marked FALSO; it does not specify recommended pressure.

NHTSA-hosted manufacturer tire safety information, Maximum Pressure Indicated on the Tire Sidewall, p. 6: https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2015/MC-10124213-9999.pdf — the sidewall may show maximum permissible pressure; vehicle recommended pressure may be lower or equal and is given on the vehicle placard or in the manual. Interpreting the quiz as asking for the recommended vehicle pressure is an inference, not its wording.

rows.text: Las medidas alternativas indicadas en el documento de circulación están previstas para el vehículo. También deben respetarse las demás características y requisitos aplicables.

issues.reason: The official question marks as true the claim that greater inner than outer tread wear can also be attributed to excessive toe-in. The checked manufacturer sources describe excessive toe-in as causing outer-shoulder wear and toe-out as causing inner-shoulder wear. The GM single-tire axle-misalignment passage does not assign inner wear specifically to toe-in; no authority was found establishing the claimed causal relationship. Independent adjudication is required without changing the printed verdict.

Pirelli, Tutto quello che c’è da sapere sulla convergenza: https://www.pirelli.com/global/it-it/road/auto/consigli/tutto-quello-che-c-e-da-sapere-sulla-convergenza-47885/ — excessive toe-in wears the outside; toe-out wears the inside.

GM 2025 Silverado 4500HD/5500HD/6500HD Owner Manual, p. 285: https://contentdelivery.ext.gm.com/bypass/gma-content-api/resources/sites/GMA/content/staging/MANUALS/9000/MA9501/en_US/1.0/25_CHEV_Silverado_4500HD_5500HD_6500HD_OM_en_US_U_85018323A_2024OCT31.pdf — both outside shoulders indicate toe-in, both inside shoulders toe-out; one tire’s inside or outside wear may indicate toe-in or toe-out combined with axle misalignment without assigning a specific pairing.
